learning_outcomes.text: Understand the place and importance of solar energy among renewable energy sources, and learn solar angles.
Learn about the arrival of solar radiation to the earth's surface and its calculations.
Learn about solar water heating systems.
Learn about electricity generation systems with solar cells.

syllabus_topics: Characteristics and application areas of solar radiation and energy
Measurement and calculations of solar radiation reaching the earth's surface
Solar collectors and operating conditions, parallel and series connection
Classification of solar water heating systems
Open and closed loop natural and forced circulation systems
Structure and application areas of solar cells
Solar cell, module, panel and system design
Other applications using solar energy; cooling, drying, pure water production, greenhouse farming, etc.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated from 40% of the in-term success and 60% of the final exam. In-term success is derived from a midterm exam (70%), two quizzes (10% each), and one assignment (10%).
